title: calendula suffruticosa subsp. cinerea
intro: Calendula suffruticosa subsp. cinerea, commonly known as Silver-leaved Pot Marigold, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family. It is used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Calendula suffruticosa subsp. cinerea include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties are flavonoids, carotenoids, and triterpenoids, including calendulin, which contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory actions.
